manifest_row.title: Save the Faculty of Forestry at the University of Toronto

screening.main_topic: Opposition to the University of Toronto's plan to abolish its standalone Faculty of Forestry and move its programs into another faculty.
screening.climate_relevance: The article argues that forests are important for carbon sequestration and that healthy forests help mitigate and adapt to climate change, using these points to support retaining a dedicated forestry faculty.
screening.reason: The main focus is university restructuring and the future of forestry education and research. Climate change is a meaningful part of the case for preserving the faculty, but it is not the article's central subject.
